statement: The back-reference index stays a superset of what every head refers to: each revision of a referrer that indexes a reference is a member of its own (referrer, revision, flag), and a revision removes only the members its document's forward record holds at or below the revision it published, so a removal that runs after a later revision indexed the reference again leaves it, and the referenced policy cannot be removed.
guards: control:ReferrerCleanupRaceTest#a revision's late removal never drops a reference a later revision indexed again - #1207
control:ReferrerCleanupRaceTest#a revision's removal that waits still removes the reference when nothing indexed it again
control:ReferrerCleanupRaceTest#a drop removes only the members it added, and a stray one blocks until a repair prunes it
control:RevisionsTest#repairing keeps what a head refers to, and what a publish still in flight indexed
control:RevisionsTest#repairing leaves a reference a later revision indexed meanwhile
